title: Business Central Gets a New Microsoft Copilot Chat Experience

chapters.title: What is the New Copilot Chat Experience
Three Information Sources: Data, Web, and AI Knowledge

features.name: Unified Copilot Chat Experience
features.description: A new modern chat interface for Business Central that combines business data, web search results, and general AI knowledge in a single conversational experience, consistent across web, mobile, and desktop platforms.
caveats: Very little information available as it's in preview
Documentation and feature detail are subject to change
Will be available over coming days or months as GA is announced

features.name: Business Central Data Integration in Chat
features.description: The chat experience can access and reason across Business Central business data, allowing users to ask questions about their data without navigating to specific pages or reports.
caveats: Requires appropriate licensing and permissions
Additional benefits available with Microsoft Copilot license

features.name: Web Search Integration in Copilot Chat
features.description: The unified chat experience can retrieve and incorporate web search results into conversations, combining external information with business context.
caveats: Information retrieval depends on appropriate query context
Subject to change during preview

features.name: Copilot and Agent Capabilities Settings Page
features.description: An administrative page where administrators can enable or disable copilot chat and other capabilities on a per-company basis.
caveats: Chat capability shows as production ready preview on the page
Availability varies by region and environment

features.name: Microsoft Copilot License Additional Benefits
features.description: Users with Microsoft Copilot licenses receive additional benefits and capabilities beyond what is available with a standard Business Central license, including access to work IQ and additional agent capabilities.
caveats: Specific additional benefits not fully detailed
Benefits will be learned over time as feature develops
Eligible for Microsoft 365 business customers

features.name: Conversational Interaction Model
features.description: A new interaction model for Business Central that enables users to ask questions in natural language through the chat interface rather than navigating pages, reports, or using APIs.
caveats: Represents a fundamental shift in user interaction patterns
Requires rethinking of UI and UX design approaches
Still in early stages of development

features.name: Agent Store Integration
features.description: The Business Central chat experience integrates with the Microsoft agent store, allowing users to access and interact with various agents (Microsoft 365 agents and others) directly within the Business Central environment without leaving to copilot web experience.
caveats: Noted as coming to full app
Limited availability in current preview

features.name: Model Selection in Chat
features.description: The chat interface includes options for users to select different AI models for their conversations.
caveats: Specific model options not detailed
Subject to change during preview period

features.name: Multi-step Reasoning in Chat
features.description: The chat experience performs multi-step reasoning across Business Central data to answer complex queries, as demonstrated when retrieving the most recent invoice for a customer.
caveats: Reasoning steps and accuracy may vary
Performance depends on available data and permissions
